audit.method: Every enumerated blob read from the specified Git tree; remoteFetched identifies a fresh verification ref. Source byte counts and canonical UTF-8 LF/binary hashes checked. All frozen edition hashes checked. Each unique immutable Git archive blob is decompressed once; every logical original entry is compared to its verified compressed/raw byte counts and SHA-256. No mutable-file timestamp or runtime-proof shortcut.

analysis.scope: Actual same-runtime growth and maintenance to the first binding capacity: 15 genuinely verified saved procedures plus five case workflows exhaust20 executable workflows. Two cold reversed-order repetitions per bank. Full refresh completes at tested bank9 and refuses at tested banks14/15; recheck admits bank14 and refuses bank15. Not a test of32 qualified procedures, different procedural algorithms, or generalized performance. All original checks, preparation, copies, refusal and restart costs retained.

scope: Actual non-force atomic main/edition109/tag push, fetched and audited. Genuine bank growth, same-bank cold maintenance pairs, unchanged verification, source refusals and abrupt near-capacity recovery. No padding, history deletion or raised limits. All342 Java engine classes unchanged. CI separate.
